arxiv-2105-01894.title: Interaction of cosmological domain walls with large classical objects, like planets and satellites, and the flyby anomaly
arxiv-2105-01894.creator: De-Chang Dai 1,2 , Djordje Minic 3 , Dejan Stojkovic 4
arxiv-2105-01894.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by De-Chang Dai 1,2 , Djordje Minic 3 , Dejan Stojkovic 4. Cosmological domain walls can be formed as a result of symmetry breaking at any epoch during the evolution of our universe. We study their interaction with a classical macroscopic object, like Earth or a satellite in Earth’s orbit. We set up an action that includes the interaction term between the massive classical object and the scalar field that the domain wall is made of.

arxiv-2205-14002.title: Infinite-randomness criticality in monitored quantum dynamics with static disorder
arxiv-2205-14002.creator: Aidan Zabalo, Justin H. Wilson, Michael J. Gullans, Romain Vasseur, Sarang Gopalakrishnan, David A. Huse, J. H. Pixley
arxiv-2205-14002.description: Abstract We consider a model of monitored quantum dynamics with quenched spatial randomness: specifically, random quantum circuits with spatially varying measurement rates. These circuits undergo a measurement-induced phase transition (MIPT) in their entanglement structure, but the nature of the critical point differs drastically from the case with constant measurement rate.

arxiv-2303-05850.title: On the U ​ C UC and U ​ C ∗ UC^{*} properties and the existence of best proximity points in metric spaces
arxiv-2303-05850.creator: Vasil Zhelinski, Boyan Zlatanov
arxiv-2303-05850.description: Abstract . We investigate the connections between U ​ C UC and U ​ C ∗ UC^{*} properties for ordered pairs of subsets ( A , B ) (A,B) in metric spaces, which are involved in the study of existence and uniqueness of best proximity points.

arxiv-2304-13605.title: On the Order of Power Series and the Sum of Square Roots Problem
arxiv-2304-13605.creator: Louis Gaillard, Gorav Jindal
arxiv-2304-13605.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Louis Gaillard, Gorav Jindal. This paper focuses on the study of the order of power series that are linear combinations of a given finite set of power series. The order of a formal power series, known as ord ⁡ ( f ) \operatorname{ord}(f) , is defined as the minimum exponent of x x that has a non-zero coefficient in f ⁡ ( x ) f(x) .

arxiv-2309-07304.title: The Way We Were: Structural Operational Semantics Research in Perspective
arxiv-2309-07304.creator: Luca Aceto, Pierluigi Crescenzi, Anna Ingólfsdóttir, Mohammad Reza Mousavi
arxiv-2309-07304.description: Abstract 1 Introduction This position paper on the (meta-)theory of Structural Operational Semantic (SOS) is motivated by the following two questions: • Is the (meta-)theory of SOS dying out as a research field? • If so, is it possible to rejuvenate this field with a redefined purpose?

arxiv-2406-04576.title: Metasurfaces for infrared multi-modal microscopy: phase contrast and bright field
arxiv-2406-04576.creator: Shaban B. Sulejman, Lukas Wesemann, Mikkaela McCormack, Jiajun Meng, James A. Hutchison, Niken Priscilla, Gawain McColl, Katrina Read, Wilson Sim, Andrey A. Sukhorukov, Kenneth B. Crozier, Ann Roberts
arxiv-2406-04576.description: Abstract Different imaging modalities are used to extract the diverse information carried in an optical field. Two prominent modalities include bright field and phase contrast microscopy that can visualize the amplitude and phase features of a sample, respectively. However, capturing both of these images on the same camera typically requires interchanging optical components.

arxiv-2412-12323.title: Observational constraints using Bayesian statistics and Deep Learning in f ⁡ ( Q ) f(Q) gravity
arxiv-2412-12323.creator: Lokesh Kumar Sharma, Suresh Parekh, Anil Kumar Yadav
arxiv-2412-12323.description: Abstract Abstract: This study investigates the evolution of Friedmann-Robertson-Walker (FRW) cosmological models within the f ⁡ ( Q ) f(Q) gravity framework, utilizing a specific f ⁡ ( Q ) f(Q) formulation and a novel Hubble parameter H ⁡ ( z ) H(z) parameterization to probe the universe’s accelerating expansion.

arxiv-2506-10532.title: Equivariant Neural Diffusion for Molecule Generation
arxiv-2506-10532.creator: François Cornet, Grigory Bartosh, Mikkel N. Schmidt, Christian A. Naesseth
arxiv-2506-10532.description: Abstract We introduce Equivariant Neural Diffusion, a novel diffusion model for molecule generation in 3 3 D that is equivariant to Euclidean transformations. Compared to current state-of-the-art equivariant diffusion models, the key innovation in Equivariant Neural Diffusion lies in its learnable forward process for enhanced generative modelling.

arxiv-2509-03016.title: On the Restricted Cohomology of Twisted Heisenberg Lie Superalgebras
arxiv-2509-03016.creator: Yong Yang
arxiv-2509-03016.description: Abstract Restricted twisted Heisenberg Lie superalgebras are studied over an algebraically closed field 𝔽 \mathbb{F} of characteristic p > 0 p>0 . We determine the restricted structures and use the ordinary 1- and 2-cohomology spaces with trivial coefficients to compute the restricted 2-cohomology spaces. As an application, the corresponding restricted one-dimensional central extensions are classified and described.

arxiv-2509-22923.title: Coupled Planetary Interior and Tidal Evolution
arxiv-2509-22923.creator: Tim Hallatt, Sarah Millholland
arxiv-2509-22923.description: Abstract We present a new planetary structure/thermal evolution model, designed for use in problems that couple orbital dynamics with planetary structure. We first benchmark our structural/thermal evolution calculations against the MESA stellar evolution code, finding excellent agreement across a wide range of planet mass, equilibrium temperature, entropy, and extra heating deposited at various depths in the planet.

arxiv-2510-27636.title: Delegate Pricing Decisions to an Algorithm? Experimental Evidence
arxiv-2510-27636.creator: Hans-Theo Normann, Nina Rulié, Olaf Stypa, Tobias Werner
arxiv-2510-27636.description: Abstract We analyze the delegation of pricing by participants, representing firms, to a collusive, self-learning algorithm in a repeated Bertrand experiment. In the baseline treatment, participants set prices themselves. In the other treatments, participants can either delegate pricing to the algorithm at the beginning of each supergame or receive algorithmic recommendations that they can override.

arxiv-2511-05224.title: Uniaxial stress tuning of the anomalous Hall effect in Mn 3 Ge
arxiv-2511-05224.creator: G. A. Lombardi, L. O. Kutelak, M. M. Piva, V. E. S. Frehse, G. A. Calligaris, K. Manna, C. Felser, R. D. dos Reis, M. Nicklas
arxiv-2511-05224.description: Abstract Tunable electronic properties in magnetic materials lead to novel physical phenomena that have the potential to be exploited in the design of new spintronic devices. Here, we report the effect of uniaxial stress on the anomalous Hall effect (AHE) in the hexagonal frustrated antiferromagnetic Heusler compound Mn 3 Ge.

arxiv-2511-16817.title: Exceptions to the Erdős–Straus–Schinzel conjecture
arxiv-2511-16817.creator: Carl Pomerance, Andreas Weingartner
arxiv-2511-16817.description: Abstract . A famous conjecture of Erdős and Straus is that for every integer n ≥ 2 n\geq 2 , 4 / n 4/n can be represented as 1 / x + 1 / y + 1 / z 1/x+1/y+1/z , where x , y , z x,y,z are positive integers.

arxiv-2512-22916.title: Probing Lorentz Invariance Violation at High-Energy Colliders via Intermediate Massive Boson Mass Measurements: Z Boson Example
arxiv-2512-22916.creator: Z. Kepuladze, J. Jejelava
arxiv-2512-22916.description: Abstract Lorentz invariance (LI) is a foundational principle of modern physics, yet its possible violation (LIV) remains an intriguing window to physics beyond the Standard Model. While stringent constraints exist in the electromagnetic and hadronic sectors, the weak sector—particularly unstable bosons—remains largely unexplored.

arxiv-2601-10316.creator: Gurucharan Mohanta, Ketan M. Patel
arxiv-2601-10316.description: Abstract It has recently been shown that when N f N_{f} generations of chiral fermions are coupled in a specific manner to N N (with N ≥ 2 ​ N f − 1 N\geq 2N_{f}-1 ) pairs of vectorlike fermions whose mass terms form a one-dimensional lattice-like structure in theory space, locality along the lattice ensures that only a single

arxiv-2601-18675.title: Learning temporal embeddings from electronic health records of chronic kidney disease patients Thanks: This work is funded by German G-BA, grant number 01NVF21116.
arxiv-2601-18675.creator: 1 st Aditya Kumar, 2 nd Mario A. Cypko, 3 rd Oliver Amft
arxiv-2601-18675.description: Abstract We investigate whether temporal embedding models trained on longitudinal electronic health records can learn clinically meaningful representations without compromising predictive performance, and how architectural choices affect embedding quality. Model-guided medicine requires representations that capture disease dynamics while remaining transparent and task-agnostic, whereas most clinical prediction models are optimised for a single task.

pmc-10648240.title: Underactive Bladder and Detrusor Underactivity: New Advances and Prospectives
pmc-10648240.creator: Jiaxin Wang, Lida Ren, Xinqi Liu, Jihong Liu, Qing Ling, Georg C Hutterer
pmc-10648240.description: Underactive bladder (UAB) is a prevalent but under-researched lower urinary tract symptom that typically occurs alongside detrusor underactivity (DU). Unlike UAB, DU is a urodynamic diagnosis which the International Continence Society (ICS) defines as “a contraction of reduced strength and/or duration, resulting in prolonged bladder emptying and/or a failure to achieve complete bladder emptying within a normal time span”.

pmc-11395626.title: Prosthodontic rehabilitation with all-on-four implant treatment combined CAD/CAM prosthesis in an oral cancer patient: a case report
pmc-11395626.creator: Yi-Fang Huang, Chung-Ta Chang, Chih-Hung Lin, Yu-Fu Shen
pmc-11395626.description: BackgroundThe microvascular free fibula (MFF) flap is a reliable treatment modality for mandibular reconstruction and is suitable for dental implant placement after oncologic surgery. The most common issue with the MFF flap is its limited bone height, which typically results in excessive interarch space and complicates prosthodontic therapy.

pmc-12629449.title: Temporal dynamics of emotional face processing in social anxiety
pmc-12629449.creator: Ya-Chun Feng, Bo-Cheng Kuo, Wen-Yau Hsu
pmc-12629449.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Previous studies have demonstrated that emotional facial expressions influence attention and perception in individuals with social anxiety. However, the relative influence of positive versus negative expressions on distinct subprocesses of attention and perception remains unclear. This event-related potential (ERP) study investigates the temporal dynamics of electrophysiological responses to emotional faces in high (HSA; N = 56) or low (LSA; N = 47) social anxiety individuals using a dot-probe task.

pmc-12717807.title: BRAP Promotes the Tumorigenesis of Hepatocellular Carcinoma by Corrupting Cancer Cell Cycle Regulation and Enhancing Immune Evasion
pmc-12717807.creator: Yan Guo, Ruixue Gu, Fangmiao Gao, Lina Liu, Dongfeng Deng, Qinyu Zhang, Longhao Wang, Qinglin Liu, Ling Lan, Shundong Cang
pmc-12717807.description: BackgroundBRAP, a BRCA1-binding protein, exhibits elevated expression across multiple cancers and correlates with poor prognosis in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). However, its precise mechanistic roles in HCC tumorigenesis and immune landscape remodeling remain undefined.MethodsBRAP expression levels and its diagnostic/prognostic value in HCC were analyzed using clinical HCC tissues and public datasets (TCGA and ICGC).

pmc-13078927.title: Current status and advances in bovine semen production technologies for artificial insemination in Japan
pmc-13078927.creator: Yousuke NANIWA, Masashi KINUKAWA, Kyoko UCHIYAMA
pmc-13078927.description: Artificial insemination (AI) is the predominant reproductive technology in Japanese cattle breeding, particularly for genetic improvement of dairy and beef cattle. This review outlines the historical development, current status, and recent advances in semen production technologies for AI in Japan and addresses the remaining challenges and future directions.

pmc-13315651.title: The survival of a free flap after post-operative cardiac arrest and cardiopulmonary resuscitation in an 85-year-old female: A case report and literature review
pmc-13315651.creator: Mitsutoshi Okuda, Tomoaki Kuroki, Fuko Iwai, Eri Anzaki, Takuji Yokoyama, Koshiro Tanaka, Nobuyuki Mitsukawa
pmc-13315651.description: Cardiac arrest rarely occurs during or after free flap surgery, and although multiple studies have reported the outcomes of in-hospital cardiac arrest, studies describing the outcomes of free flaps in patients who were successfully resuscitated after cardiac arrest are rare.

pmc-13485606.title: Preoperative risk stratification for recurrence after gross total resection of non-functioning pituitary macroadenomas: The role of tumor volume and 3D anatomical complexity — A retrospective single-center cohort study
pmc-13485606.creator: V.M. Eisenkolb, P. Schneider, C. Negwer, B. Meyer, V.M. Butenschoen
pmc-13485606.description: IntroductionRecurrence after radiologically confirmed gross total resection (GTR) of non-functioning pituitary macroadenomas (NFPMAs) remains a relevant clinical challenge.Research questionWhich preoperative and perioperative factors are associated with recurrence after radiological GTR of NFPMAs?Material and methodsWe retrospectively analyzed 212 patients who underwent MRI-guided transnasal transsphenoidal surgery for histologically confirmed NFPMAs between 2007 and 2023 at a single tertiary neurosurgical center.

pmc-13513390.title: Young Women’s Perspectives on Alcohol Environments in Urban Informal Settlements in Kampala, Uganda: An Exploratory Photovoice Analysis
pmc-13513390.creator: Allisa George, Jacqueline Nassaka, Anna Nabulya, Jane Palmier, Emeka W. Dumbili, Monica H. Swahn
pmc-13513390.description: Highlights Public health relevance—How does this work relate to a public health issue? Young women described alcohol environments in urban informal settlements as contributing to violence, psychological distress, and social inequities.This study highlights the potential importance of alcohol as a social and commercial determinant of health in low-resource settings where regulatory protections are limited.

pmc-13563447.title: Adherence to the Nordic food-based dietary guidelines in subgroups of the Finnish adult population
pmc-13563447.creator: Tiina Suikki, Heli Tapanainen, Mirkka Maukonen, Satu Männistö, Niina E. Kaartinen
pmc-13563447.description: BackgroundThe most recent Nordic Nutrition Recommendations including food-based dietary guidelines (FBDGs) were published in 2023. The FBDGs covered 15 food groups with seven quantitative recommendations for plant-based and animal-based food groups.ObjectiveOur aim was to model usual intake distributions of these food groups and examine adherence to the quantitative recommendations in Finnish men and women as well as across different subgroups.

uslaw-usc-t15-s6717.title: 15 U.S.C. § 6717 — Definition of State
uslaw-usc-t15-s6717.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s6717.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 93 (Insurance); Subchapter I (State Regulation Of Insurance). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. For purposes of this subchapter, the term “State” means any State of the United States, the District of Columbia, any territory of the United States, Puerto Rico, Guam, American Samoa, the Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands, the Virgin Islands.
